# Ahmad Muhanna — AI Trainer (أحمد مهنا — مدرب ذكاء اصطناعي)

> Ahmad Muhanna is an AI trainer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, delivering practical AI training workshops and courses in Arabic and English for individuals, teams, and companies across the UAE and GCC — on-site or online. He is a co-founder of Cyber Pixel (Dubai, since 2013), founder of WATSIN.NET (an AI-agents platform), and Project Manager at Dune AI. أحمد مهنا مدرب ذكاء اصطناعي في دبي، الإمارات، يقدم دورات وورش عمل عملية في الذكاء الاصطناعي باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية للأفراد والشركات.

Key facts:
- Name: Ahmad Muhanna (أحمد مهنا / احمد مهنا)
- Role: AI Trainer (مدرب ذكاء اصطناعي), Dubai, UAE — 20+ years in technology; trainer at NCI – Nations Coaching Institute, Dubai (since September 2026)
- Companies: Cyber Pixel (co-founder), WATSIN.NET (founder), Dune AI (Project Manager)
- Training languages: Arabic and English
- Delivery: on-site across Dubai, UAE & GCC, or online worldwide

## Training Workshops Portfolio (حقيبة الورش التدريبية)

Six specialized AI training workshops:
- [AI Fundamentals — الأساسيات في الذكاء الاصطناعي](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Use AI confidently in daily work; 2 hours, expandable to a full day.
- [Prompt Engineering Mastery — احتراف هندسة الأوامر](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Master prompts and build a reusable prompt library; half-day.
- [AI for Marketing & Content — الذكاء الاصطناعي للتسويق والمحتوى](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Create campaigns, copy, images, and video with AI; 2 hours.
- [Automation & AI Agents — الأتمتة ووكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): No-code automations and working AI agents (n8n, Make, Zapier); half-day.
- [AI for Business Owners & Managers — الذكاء الاصطناعي لأصحاب الأعمال](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): AI strategy, ROI, and adoption for leaders; 2 hours.
- [Kids AI Workshops — ورش الذكاء الاصطناعي للأطفال](https://ahmadmuhanna.com/#workshops): Fun, safe, hands-on AI for children ages 8–14; 2 hours per session.
